Package org.apache.juneau.console

Interface CardTypeHandler

All Known Implementing Classes:
ChartCardType, DatatablesCardType, HtmlCardType, InventoryGaugeCardType, JobLogCardType, TerminalCardType
public interface CardTypeHandler
Server half of a console card type: validates an authored card and returns its page-contract fragment. Rendering is never done here; the JS handler registered under the same type() renders the fragment.

A type with no registered handler uses the generic passthrough (JSON5 body becomes the fragment, markup body becomes a template), so most custom cards need only JS. Register a handler when the server must validate or enrich the body.

Example:

public final class KpiCardType implements CardTypeHandler { @Override public String type() { return "kpi"; } @Override public JsonMap toFragment(CardSource src) { JsonMap b = src.json(); // E-24 on bad JSON5 if (! b.containsKey("value")) throw src.error("type='kpi' requires 'value'."); return b; } } // Registration (either): ConsoleFreemarkerMixin.create().cardType(new KpiCardType()).build(); // or META-INF/services/org.apache.juneau.console.CardTypeHandler

Since:
10.0.0

  • Method Details

    • type

      String type()
      The type name this handler serves.
      Returns:
      The type name; must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$ (E-21).

    • toFragment

      JsonMap toFragment(CardSource source)
      Validates the authored card and returns its contract fragment.
      Parameters:
      source - The authored card (attributes plus body).
      Returns:
      The fragment merged flat onto the card's base keys; must not contain a reserved key (E-23).
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - via CardSource.error(String, Object...) on invalid input.

    • implicitTopics

      default List<String> implicitTopics(JsonMap card)
      Topics this card publishes without declaring them, for R-10. Default: none (the shell adds card:/cmd:).
      Example:

      @Override public List<String> implicitTopics(JsonMap card) { return List.of("kpi.threshold-crossed"); }

      Parameters:
      card - The card object from the page contract (base keys plus this type's fragment).
      Returns:
      The concrete topics (or ns.name:* patterns) the type's JS publishes for this card.

    • acceptedRoles

      default Set<String> acceptedRoles()
      Roles this type accepts in subscribes[].as, beyond refresh and params. null (the default) means "unknown to Java": the Java validator skips E-44 and the JS check (E-JS-47) decides.
      Example:

      @Override public Set<String> acceptedRoles() { return Set.of("highlight"); }

      Returns:
      The accepted role names, or null if unknown.

    • acceptedOps

      default Set<String> acceptedOps()
      cmd:<id> ops this type handles, beyond the shell's refresh, for E-43 on a ribbon target. null (the default) means "unknown to Java": the Java validator skips the check and the JS shell reports an unhandled op at runtime (E-JS-48).
      Example:

      @Override public Set<String> acceptedOps() { return Set.of("set-target"); }

      Returns:
      The handled op names, or null if unknown.

    • requiredPacks

      default List<String> requiredPacks(JsonMap body)
      Toolkit packs this card needs because of what its body declares, beyond the packs its type always needs. Unioned with the type's packs and the card's requires=. Default: none.
      Example:

      @Override public List<String> requiredPacks(JsonMap body) { return body.containsKey("terminal") ? List.of("terminal") : List.of(); }

      Parameters:
      body - The card's body: this type's fragment, as toFragment(CardSource) returned it.
      Returns:
      The pack names; each must be a registered pack.
